profiles.speaker: TED
profiles.voice_description: A gravelly older male voice in his late sixties with a rough coastal British accent, weathered by salt and tobacco. Gruff, dry and snarky, slow to warm up, with a rasp and an occasional cough. Speaks in short barking sentences.
profiles.preview_text: Eclipse, storm season, and the Saltgate howling. Of course they send a new money toff. Boiler's cold and the beacon's starving. Down to the engine room. Shovel coal, Isaac.
canon_basis: chr_ted voice_casting_notes: gravelly older male, coastal accent
profiles.contrast_note: Lowest and slowest of the three; gravel and rasp where Arthur is reedy and Daniel bright.

profiles.speaker: ARTHUR
profiles.voice_description: A wiry, old male voice, reedy and thin, with a coastal sailor's accent. Wry and warm underneath, quick and frantic under pressure, voice cracking when he shouts over wind and an engine.
profiles.preview_text: Easy now, we mean no harm. Just cold and wet. The gate, please? Good hands on that gate. Daniel, move. Quick, now.
profiles.contrast_note: Higher and faster than Ted, thin and reedy; older and more cracked than Daniel.

profiles.speaker: DANIEL
profiles.voice_description: A young male voice in his early twenties, bright and enthusiastic, soft coastal accent. Light-hearted and chatty, with nervous laughs and a voice that thins and speeds up when anxious.
profiles.preview_text: Down here suits me fine. Did the walls just... never mind. Warm is good. Arthur says it's just weather. I'm sure Arthur's right. He's usually right. Mostly.
profiles.contrast_note: The only young voice: bright and quick, where Ted and Arthur are older.

lines.tts_text: Eclipse, storm season, and the Saltgate howling. Of course they send a new money toff. [coughs]
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Boiler's cold and the beacon's starving. Down to the engine room. Shovel coal, Isaac.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: That's the firebox. Feed it coal, mind your sleeves, and don't stand gawping.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: There she goes. Keep shovelling; the needle won't climb on good intentions.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Gauge is waking up. Put your back into it.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Hear that dynamo whine? Good. Now up to the lantern room and look over the arc lamp.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Arc lamp's in the middle. Open her up and look at the burner.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Cracked clean through. The burner's finished. Hrmph. Nothing to mend up here. [coughs]
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Standing there won't warm the boiler. Think where the heat comes from, Isaac.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Basement, Isaac. The engine room. Coal's piled by the firebox.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Go down to the engine room. Take the shovel. Load coal into the firebox.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Rowboat's moored at my dock. Stranded sailors, by the look. Go let them in at the island gate.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: See them? Soaked and stranded. The gate's down the path from the dock. Go on.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Easy now, we mean no harm. Just cold and wet. The gate, please?
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Good hands on that gate. Daniel, move. Quick, now.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Ted, you old rock. Thought you'd be drowned by now.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Thought the same of you. Hrmph. Dry yourselves. The boy can warm up downstairs. [coughs]
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Down here suits me fine. Did the walls just... never mind. Warm is good.
lines.speaker: DANIEL

lines.tts_text: Arthur says it's just weather. I'm sure Arthur's right. He's usually right. Mostly. [nervous laugh]
lines.speaker: DANIEL

lines.tts_text: [breathless] Did you hear that? Tell me you heard that. Pipes, right? Say pipes.
lines.speaker: DANIEL

lines.tts_text: [whispers] Don't listen to it. Wind makes all sorts of voices. Hum something. I'm humming. [nervous laugh]
lines.speaker: DANIEL

lines.tts_text: Those sailors won't dry themselves on my dock, Isaac.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: The gate, Isaac. Down the path from the dock. Someone's shouting out there.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: Walk to the island gate and open it. Let them in.
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: No burner, no beacon. Outpost, across the Gullwater. Go with Arthur, Isaac. [coughs]
lines.speaker: TED

lines.tts_text: In you get. One hand on the wheel, eyes on the rocks.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Keep her off the rocks, Isaac. Watch the water, not the dark.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: [breathless] Too close! Give the rocks some room, Isaac.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Hold on! Swing wide of the rock and steer clear. Gently now.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: [hushed] There! Ship's lights, out in the swell. She can't see the rocks. No beacon.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: There's the landing. Fetch the burner. I'll keep the engine turning.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Nothing there for us. Leave it be. The burner, the burner.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: That's it? Good. Hold it close. Back across we go.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Ted wants that burner, Isaac. Boat's waiting on you.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Come on! The outpost, across the Gullwater. Get in the boat.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Board the boat, take the wheel, steer for the outpost landing. Go!
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Burner won't walk to the boat, Isaac.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Find the burner! Keep looking. Look sharp!
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

lines.tts_text: Find the burner, pick it up, and bring it to the boat.
lines.speaker: ARTHUR

suggestions: Audition Ted first: his cough tags depend on v3 handling them well.
